podcast.title: Mother of Daisy Lowe
podcast.body: She is the mother of Daisy Lowe, born January 27, 1989. Daisy's birth certificate initially listed Pearl's husband as the father, but later blood tests revealed Gavin Rossdale was the biological father. "Little Daisy Low was born on January 27th, 1989. Her birth certificate listed Pearl's husband as the father."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Relationship with Gavin Rossdale
podcast.body: Pearl Lowe, a singer, songwriter, and fashion designer, had a one-night stand with Gavin Rossdale in the spring of 1988 while she was married to another man. "Now Pearl is a singer, songwriter, a turned fashion designer. And at some point in the spring of 1988, she had a one-nighter with Gavin."

xref.title: Paternity of Daisy Lowe
xref.body: Fifteen years after their encounter, blood tests confirmed that Gavin Rossdale was the biological father of Daisy Lowe, who was born on January 27, 1989. Daisy's birth certificate had initially listed Pearl Lowe's husband as the father. "15 years later, Little Daisy started asking some interesting and awkward questions about dad. Like, is daddy my real dad? That kind of thing. Blood tests were done. And guess what? Gavin was the daddy."

xref.title: Previous Relationship with Pearl Lowe
xref.body: Before his fame with Bush in the 1990s, Gavin Rossdale had a relationship with Pearl Lowe, a singer, songwriter, and fashion designer. They had a one-night stand in the spring of 1988 while Pearl was married, but not to Gavin. "But before then he was in a relationship with a woman named Pearl Low."
